claim_text: At Fortescue, our purpose is clear: to accelerate decarbonisation on a global scale, rapidly and profitably.
context_text: At Fortescue, our purpose is clear: to accelerate decarbonisation on a global scale, rapidly and profitably.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 这是高度概括性的气候主张，但报告该处未提供任何可量化的全球范围减碳成效或盈利性数据，属于无实际绩效支撑的漂绿嫌疑。
notes: 封面/概览式purpose表述，无配套FY2025实际绩效数据。
